note: What the connector stubs return in the e2e flagship run: items with an id, a link, when they last changed, and their text. Two fall outside 2026-07-01..2026-09-30 so the run has to keep to the period.

items.text: Publish captured payments to the ledger through the event bus instead of a direct HTTP call. Checkout is unaffected.
Refunds post a reversing entry to the ledger; the ledger rejects a refund larger than its charge.
Checkout opens a session, payments authorizes and captures with the processor, and the ledger records every capture as a balanced posting.
Monitors: processor latency p95, ledger posting lag, checkout error rate. One Sev2 on 2026-09-12: ledger posting lag above 5 minutes.
We agreed the ledger consumer reads from the payments topic and acknowledges only after the posting commits.
Add the ledger consumer behind a flag; payments still posts over HTTP until the flag flips.
Q3: event bus for payments-to-ledger; Q4: multi-currency ledger accounts.
Initial ledger service, posting over HTTP.
Flip the ledger consumer flag on in staging.
